summary: @servicetitan/forge preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (node setup.mjs) that downloads a Bun runtime zip from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip) into a temp directory, extracts and chmods the Bun binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js during npm install. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header // @bun @bun-cjs) containing a shuffled string-array decoder and opaque numeric constants — the content is not human-readable and does not correspond to any functionality expected from a React UI component library. setup.mjs itself is control-flow-obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming such as _0x488df8/_0x52943e and per-function string dictionaries) and includes Alpine/musl probing (ldd --version, /etc/os-release) to select bun-linux-x64-musl-baseline, extending platform coverage. The result is an alternate-runtime-dropper: an opaque payload delivered to installers and executed under a freshly-fetched second runtime that the Node-based install environment does not introspect, on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
